background_notes.fact: For an extended nonnegative real x and k∈ℕ, if x≤(k:ℝ≥0∞), then 0≤x≤(k:ℝ≥0∞)<∞, 0≤x.toReal≤(k:ℝ), and ENNReal.ofReal(x.toReal)=x.

grounds.reason: The bound n is a natural number, so its extended nonnegative real embedding is finite.
At x=dimH E and k=n, E008 supplies x≤k.
Hausdorff dimension has codomain ℝ≥0∞.
D is x.toReal; toReal and ofReal have the specified finite-value and embedding meanings.

background_notes.justification: Zero is the least extended nonnegative real, and the embedding of a natural number has finite value. An element below that finite bound cannot be infinity, hence is the embedding of a unique real u≥0. Order on finite embedded values is ordinary real order, so u≤k. By the finite-value definition toReal x=u; since u≥0, ofReal u embeds u unchanged and thus equals x. This routine order identification applies also when k=0.

background_notes.fact: For real s,t≥0, ENNReal.ofReal s≤ENNReal.ofReal t iff s≤t, and ENNReal.ofReal s<ENNReal.ofReal t iff s<t. For every real r, ENNReal.ofReal r<∞. For s,t≥0, ENNReal.ofReal(s+t)=ENNReal.ofReal s+ENNReal.ofReal t, and ENNReal.ofReal 1=1.

grounds.reason: ofReal is the canonical embedding of max(r,0) into the extended nonnegative reals.
D is nonnegative and its embedding equals dimH E.
Under L1, q>D≥0; the displayed comparison therefore lies in the nonnegative range.

background_notes.justification: The extended nonnegative reals adjoin a greatest element to the nonnegative real half-line.
